Code repository for standardizing and importing the [Dataset Name] ([DATASET_CODE]) into the Open Soil Spectral Library (OSSL).

Website: [Soil Spectroscopy for Global Good](https://soilspectroscopy.org)  
Development: <https://github.com/soilspectroscopy>  
Last update: `r Sys.Date()`  

## Original data

[Describe the origin, geographical scope, sampling design, and main soil properties of the dataset. Add reference citation, e.g., @dataset_citation_key].

Input files:  
- `[raw_metadata_file].csv`: File containing site and geographic coordinates.  
- `[raw_soillab_file].csv`: File containing wet chemistry / laboratory analytical reference data.  
- `[raw_spectra_file].csv`: File containing spectral scans (MIR and/or VisNIR).  

```{r packages, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
packages <- c("tidyverse", "data.table", "lubridate", "units", "readxl", "stringr",
              "googledrive", "googlesheets4", "tmap", "sf", "rnaturalearth",
              "skimr", "prospectr", "tictoc", "nanoparquet", "fs")

invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

source("../../R/functions/SSL_functions.R")

# Google Sheets authentication (only needed if fetching standardization tables online)
# gs4_auth(path = "~/secrets/soilcarbon-soilspec-845d0d3f2fbe.json")
```

Directory/folder path with original files (raw data files are not tracked in GitHub). 
```{r dir}
# Specify dataset code and raw data directory
dataset_code <- "[DATASET_CODE]" # e.g. "CAF", "AUT"
dir <- file.path("~/mnt-ossl-private/database/datasets", dataset_code)
# Alternatively, use local path during development:
# dir <- file.path("./data")

tic()
```

## Data standardization to the OSSL format

### Site information

Ingesting site coordinates, sampling dates, USDA depth layers, and administrative boundaries.
Refer to `out/ossl_level0_names_soilsite.csv` for allowed column names and descriptions.

```{r soilsite}
# TODO: Read raw metadata file
raw_metadata <- fread(path(dir, "[raw_metadata_file].csv"), header = TRUE)

dataset.sitedata <- raw_metadata %>%
  # TODO: Select and rename relevant columns to OSSL Level 0 names
  select(sample_id, latitude, longitude, upper_depth, lower_depth) %>%
  rename(id.layer_local_c = sample_id,
         latitude.point_wgs84_dd = latitude,
         longitude.point_wgs84_dd = longitude,
         layer.upper.depth_usda_cm = upper_depth,
         layer.lower.depth_usda_cm = lower_depth) %>%
  mutate(id.layer_local_c = as.character(id.layer_local_c)) %>%
  # Calculate USDA layer sequence (1 for top layer, 2+ for deeper layers)
  mutate(layer.sequence_usda_uint16 = ifelse(layer.upper.depth_usda_cm == 0, 1, 2)) %>%
  # Set dataset code and generate unique layer UUID
  mutate(dataset.code_ascii_txt = dataset_code,
         id.layer_uuid_txt = openssl::md5(paste0(dataset.code_ascii_txt, id.layer_local_c)),
         .before = 1) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("id."), as.character))

# Saving standardized version to dataset root directory
site.exp.file <- path(dir, "ossl_soilsite_v1.3")
readr::write_csv(dataset.sitedata, str_c(site.exp.file, ".csv.gz"))
nanoparquet::write_parquet(dataset.sitedata, str_c(site.exp.file, ".parquet"))
```

Plotting spatial distribution:
```{r map, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
data("World")
ocean <- ne_download(scale = 110, type = "ocean", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")

points <- dataset.sitedata %>%
  filter(!is.na(longitude.point_wgs84_dd),
         !is.na(latitude.point_wgs84_dd)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude.point_wgs84_dd", "latitude.point_wgs84_dd"), crs = 4326)

tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(ocean) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "lightblue", col = NA) +
  tm_shape(World) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "#f0f0f0", fill_alpha = 0.5, col_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_shape(points) +
  tm_dots(fill = "firebrick", size = 0.5) +
  tm_crs("ESRI:54030") +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)
```

### Soil lab information (reference analytical data)

#### 1. Extracting original column names (run once)
Run this chunk once when initiating the dataset to create `soillab_original_names.csv`. You can then map the columns in `soillab_standardized_names.csv` (either locally or on Google Sheets).

```{r soil_template, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
raw_soildata <- fread(path(dir, "[raw_soillab_file].csv"), header = TRUE)

soillab.names <- raw_soildata %>%
  names(.) %>%
  tibble(original_name = .) %>%
  mutate(table = "[raw_soillab_file].csv", .before = 1) %>%
  mutate(import = "", original_unit = "", original_method = "", comment = "",
         ossl_abbrev = "", ossl_method = "", ossl_unit = "", ossl_convert = "", ossl_name = "",
         .after = original_name)

readr::write_csv(soillab.names, path(getwd(), "soillab_original_names.csv"))

# Optional: Upload to Google Sheet for collaborative mapping
# ss_id <- "1mWTDJDuMp4oObcCxAy9gofSkrkcSWWf1TtEW2SuC1es"
# googlesheets4::write_sheet(soillab.names, ss = ss_id, sheet = dataset_code)
```

#### 2. Downloading edited standardization rules (if using Google Sheets)
```{r soillab_download, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}

# transvalues <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(ss_id, sheet = dataset_code)
# write_csv(transvalues, path(getwd(), "soillab_standardized_names.csv"))
```

#### 3. Standardizing soil laboratory properties
```{r soilab_preparation, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# Read standardization rules from local CSV
transvalues <- read_csv(path(getwd(), "soillab_standardized_names.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(import == TRUE) %>%
  select(contains(c("table", "id", "original_name", "ossl_")))

knitr::kable(transvalues)

# Read raw soil data
dataset.reference <- fread(path(dir, "[raw_soillab_file].csv"), header = TRUE)

analytes.old.names <- transvalues %>%
  filter(table == "[raw_soillab_file].csv") %>%
  pull(original_name)

analytes.new.names <- transvalues %>%
  filter(table == "[raw_soillab_file].csv") %>%
  pull(ossl_name)

# Select and rename mapped columns
dataset.soildata <- dataset.reference %>%
  rename(id.layer_local_c = [sample_id_column]) %>%
  select(id.layer_local_c, all_of(analytes.old.names)) %>%
  rename_with(~analytes.new.names, all_of(analytes.old.names)) %>%
  mutate(id.layer_local_c = as.character(id.layer_local_c)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Extract conversion formulas (first entry is "x" for id.layer_local_c)
functions.list <- transvalues %>%
  filter(table == "[raw_soillab_file].csv") %>%
  mutate(ossl_name = factor(ossl_name, levels = names(dataset.soildata))) %>%
  arrange(ossl_name) %>%
  pull(ossl_convert) %>%
  c("x", .)

# Apply value transformations and unit conversions
dataset.soildata.trans <- transform_values(df = dataset.soildata,
                                           out.name = names(dataset.soildata),
                                           in.name = names(dataset.soildata),
                                           fun.lst = functions.list)

dataset.soildata <- dataset.soildata.trans %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("id."), as.character))

# Export standardized soil lab data
soillab.exp.file <- path(dir, "ossl_soillab_v1.3")
readr::write_csv(dataset.soildata, str_c(soillab.exp.file, ".csv.gz"))
nanoparquet::write_parquet(dataset.soildata, str_c(soillab.exp.file, ".parquet"))
```

Soil lab summary:
```{r soil_lab_summary, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
dataset.soildata %>%
  mutate(id.layer_local_c = factor(id.layer_local_c)) %>%
  skimr::skim() %>%
  dplyr::select(-numeric.hist, -complete_rate)
```

### Spectral data

#### Mid-infrared spectra (MIR)
OSSL standardizes MIR to absorbance units from 600 to 4000 cm⁻¹ with a 2 cm⁻¹ step (`scan_mir.600_abs` to `scan_mir.4000_abs`).

```{r mir, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# TODO: Read raw MIR file
raw_mir <- fread(path(dir, "[raw_spectra_mir_file].csv"), header = TRUE)

dataset.mir <- raw_mir %>%
  rename(id.layer_local_c = [sample_id_column]) %>%
  mutate(id.layer_local_c = as.character(id.layer_local_c))

# Resampling to OSSL target grid (600 to 4000 cm-1 by 2)
old.wavenumbers <- na.omit(as.numeric(names(dataset.mir)[-1]))
new.wavenumbers <- rev(seq(600, 4000, by = 2))

dataset.mir.resampled <- dataset.mir %>%
  select(-id.layer_local_c) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  prospectr::resample(X = ., wav = old.wavenumbers,
                      new.wav = new.wavenumbers, interpol = "spline") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  bind_cols({dataset.mir %>% select(id.layer_local_c)}, .) %>%
  select(id.layer_local_c, as.character(rev(new.wavenumbers)))

# Quality Control Checks
# 1. Proportion of NA gaps
scans.na.gaps <- dataset.mir.resampled %>%
  select(-id.layer_local_c) %>%
  apply(., 1, function(x) round(100 * (sum(is.na(x))) / length(x), 2)) %>%
  tibble(proportion_NA = .) %>%
  bind_cols({dataset.mir.resampled %>% select(id.layer_local_c)}, .)

# 2. Extreme negative values (< -1)
scans.extreme.neg <- dataset.mir.resampled %>%
  select(-id.layer_local_c) %>%
  apply(., 1, function(x) round(100 * (sum(x < -1, na.rm = TRUE)) / length(x), 2)) %>%
  tibble(proportion_lower0 = .) %>%
  bind_cols({dataset.mir.resampled %>% select(id.layer_local_c)}, .)

# 3. Extreme positive values (> 5)
scans.extreme.pos <- dataset.mir.resampled %>%
  select(-id.layer_local_c) %>%
  apply(., 1, function(x) round(100 * (sum(x > 5, na.rm = TRUE)) / length(x), 2)) %>%
  tibble(proportion_higherAbs5 = .) %>%
  bind_cols({dataset.mir.resampled %>% select(id.layer_local_c)}, .)

# Consistency summary
scans.summary <- scans.na.gaps %>%
  left_join(scans.extreme.neg, by = "id.layer_local_c") %>%
  left_join(scans.extreme.pos, by = "id.layer_local_c")

scans.summary %>%
  select(-id.layer_local_c) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "check", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(value > 0) %>%
  group_by(check) %>%
  summarise(problematic_scans = n())

# Rename columns to standard OSSL format: scan_mir.XXXX_abs
target.wavenumbers <- seq(600, 4000, by = 2)
formatted.wavenumbers <- paste0("scan_mir.", target.wavenumbers, "_abs")

dataset.mir.export <- dataset.mir.resampled %>%
  rename_with(~formatted.wavenumbers, as.character(target.wavenumbers))

# Export standardized MIR data
mir.exp.file <- path(dir, "ossl_mir_v1.3")
readr::write_csv(dataset.mir.export, str_c(mir.exp.file, ".csv.gz"))
nanoparquet::write_parquet(dataset.mir.export, str_c(mir.exp.file, ".parquet"))
```

#### Visible and Near-infrared spectra (VisNIR)
*(Optional / If available in dataset: Standardized to fraction reflectance 0-1, from 350 to 2500 nm by 2 nm: `scan_visnir.350_ref` to `scan_visnir.2500_ref`)*

## Quality control & Table verification

Checking joins across site, soil lab, and spectral tables:
```{r bind_test, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
dataset.availability <- dataset.mir.export %>%
  select(id.layer_local_c, scan_mir.600_abs) %>%
  left_join(dataset.soildata, by = "id.layer_local_c") %>%
  filter(!is.na(id.layer_local_c))

# Data completeness
dataset.availability %>%
  mutate_all(as.character) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(column) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

# Check for duplicate sample IDs
repeats_summary <- dataset.availability %>%
  group_by(id.layer_local_c) %>%
  summarise(repeats = n()) %>%
  group_by(repeats) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

knitr::kable(repeats_summary, caption = "Observation repeats check")
```

MIR spectral visualization (sample of up to 100 spectra):
```{r mir_plot, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
set.seed(42)
sample_n_count <- min(100, nrow(dataset.mir.export))

dataset.mir.export %>%
  sample_n(sample_n_count) %>%
  select(id.layer_local_c, starts_with("scan_mir.")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-id.layer_local_c, names_to = "wavenumber", values_to = "absorbance") %>%
  mutate(wavenumber = as.numeric(gsub("scan_mir.|_abs", "", wavenumber))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = wavenumber, y = absorbance, group = id.layer_local_c)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.15, color = "darkblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(600, 4000, by = 600), transform = "reverse") +
  labs(x = bquote("Wavenumber"~(cm^-1)), y = "Absorbance",
       title = paste("Spectral preview (n =", sample_n_count, ")")) +
  theme_light()
```

```{r end}
toc()
rm(list = ls())
gc()
```
